definition.en: Organisms of the same kind living and reproducing in a place at a time.
definition.zh: 在一定地点和时间生活、繁殖的同类生物。

definition.en: Different populations living together in a place.
definition.zh: 生活在同一地方的不同种群。

definition.en: The place where an organism lives, with its surrounding conditions.
definition.zh: 生物生活的地方，以及周围的环境条件。

definition.en: A coastal forest with trees suited to intertidal conditions and its associated habitat.
definition.zh: 树木能应对潮间带条件的海岸森林，以及相关的生境。

definition.en: Here, a plant or alga that uses sunlight to make food. The live tree supplies leaf material; dead leaves are not producers.
definition.zh: 在这里，指利用阳光制造食物的植物或藻类。活树供应叶片，死叶本身不是生产者。

definition.en: An organism that obtains food from other organisms or their material.
definition.zh: 从其他生物或其物质获得食物的生物。

definition.en: An organism, such as a bacterium or fungus, that breaks down dead organic material and obtains energy from it.
definition.zh: 分解死亡有机物、并从中获得能量的生物，例如细菌和真菌。

definition.en: The animal that catches and eats another animal in a particular feeding relationship.
definition.zh: 在某一取食关系中，捕捉并吃掉另一动物的一方。

definition.en: The animal caught and eaten in a particular feeding relationship.
definition.zh: 在某一取食关系中，被捕捉和吃掉的动物。

definition.en: A single pathway showing food passing to consumers. The arrows point from food to the organism eating it.
definition.zh: 显示食物传给消费者的一条路径；箭头从食物指向取食者。

definition.en: Connected food chains that share organisms or functional groups. This topic selects only some possible links.
definition.zh: 共享生物或功能组、彼此相连的食物链。本主题只选入部分可能关系。

definition.en: A structure or behaviour that helps an organism cope with conditions, feed, avoid predators or reproduce.
definition.zh: 帮助生物应对条件、取食、避开捕食者或繁殖的结构或行为。

definition.en: In this model, an upright root of Api-api Putih connected to shallow lateral roots; it takes in oxygen above the muddy soil.
definition.zh: 本模型中指 Api-api Putih 从浅层侧根向上伸出的根，在泥面上方吸收氧气。

definition.en: A root that reaches down from a trunk or branch and supports the tree in soft mud, as in Bakau Minyak.
definition.zh: 从干或枝向下伸入泥中、支撑树体的根，例如 Bakau Minyak 的根。

definition.en: The shore zone that changes between covered and exposed as tides rise and fall.
definition.zh: 随着潮水涨退，在被水覆盖与露出之间变化的岸带。

definition.en: Fragments of dead organic material, such as broken leaf matter. It is not the same as human litter.
definition.zh: 死亡有机物的碎片，例如碎叶；不等于人丢弃的垃圾。

definition.en: A group of crabs whose males have one enlarged claw and one small feeding claw. This does not describe every crab.
definition.zh: 一类雄体有一只大螯和一只取食小螯的蟹；不是所有蟹都这样。
